newsitem.title: USA: Alco Standard names Robert Kearns II CFO.
newsitem.headline: Alco Standard names Robert Kearns II CFO.

text.p: Alco Standard Corp said Monday that Robert Kearns has been elected chief financial officer and senior vice president.
Kearns was vice president of finance for IKON Office Solutions, a company operated by Alco that had about $4.1 billion in revenues for fiscal 1996.
The chief financial officer's position has been vacant, company spokeswoman Suzanne Shenk said.
Kearns will head Alco after it spins off Unisource Worldwide Inc, a paper products and supply distributor. After the spin-off, Alco will be left with its IKON business, Shenk said.
